async function(ctx) {    var s = ctx.$dataModels.state.singleTable.selectedRow; if (!s || !s.name || !s.id) { ctx.$vueGlobal.$message.warning('请先点击表格中的一行有效数据'); return; } ctx.$vueGlobal.$msgbox.confirm('确认启用供应商"' + s.name + '"吗？', '确认启用', { confirmButtonText: '确定', cancelButtonText: '取消', type: 'warning' }).then(async () => { await ctx.$requestFns.toggleStatus({ id: s.id, isBlackList: 0 });  ctx.$sharedFns.searchTable(ctx); ctx.$vueGlobal.$message.success('启用成功'); }).catch(() => { ctx.$vueGlobal.$message.info('取消启用'); }); }

onCurrentChange.fn: function(ctx, payload) {const selectedRow = payload.currentRow; console.log('ctx.$dataModels', ctx); ctx.$dataModels.state.singleTable.selectedRow = selectedRow; const btnEdit = ctx.getNode('Button::btn-edit'); const btnEnable = ctx.getNode('Button::btn-enable'); const btnDisable = ctx.getNode('Button::btn-disable'); const btnDelete = ctx.getNode('Button::btn-delete'); if (selectedRow) { if (btnEdit?.updateProps) btnEdit.updateProps({ disabled: selectedRow.isBlackList === 0 }); if (btnEnable?.updateProps) btnEnable.updateProps({ disabled: selectedRow.isBlackList === 0 }); if (btnDisable?.updateProps) btnDisable.updateProps({ disabled: selectedRow.isBlackList === 1 }); if (btnDelete?.updateProps) btnDelete.updateProps({ disabled: selectedRow.isBlackList === 0 }); } else { if (btnEdit?.updateProps) btnEdit.updateProps({ disabled: true }); if (btnEnable?.updateProps) btnEnable.updateProps({ disabled: true }); if (btnDisable?.updateProps) btnDisable.updateProps({ disabled: true }); if (btnDelete?.updateProps) btnDelete.updateProps({ disabled: true }); }  }

onValueRender.fn: function(ctx, payload) { var row = payload.value; if (row && row.isBlackList) return { type: 'danger', content: '停用', effect: 'light' }; return { type: 'success', content: '启用', effect: 'light' }; }

async function(ctx) {const form=ctx.getNode('Form::supplier-form');const f=ctx.$dataModels.editForm.singleTable;   const typeJson=f.cooperationTypelist;f.cooperationType=Array.isArray(typeJson)&&typeJson.length>0?typeJson.join(','):'';if(form){const isValid=await form.exposed.validateForm();if(isValid){if(ctx.$dataModels.state.singleTable.isEdit){await ctx.$requestFns.updateSupplier(Object.assign({id:ctx.$dataModels.state.singleTable.selectedRow.id},f));}else{await ctx.$requestFns.addSupplier(f);}const d=ctx.getNode('Dialog::supplierDialog');if(d)d.exposed.close();ctx.$dataModels.state.singleTable.selectedRow=null; ctx.$sharedFns.searchTable(ctx,{isReset:!ctx.$dataModels.state.singleTable.isEdit});}else{console.error('form is not valid');}}else{console.error('form is null');}}

searchTable.fn: function(ctx, payload) {var f = ctx.$dataModels.filter?.singleTable || {}; const data = Object.assign({}, f, {cooperationTypeJson: f.cooperationTypeJson? f.cooperationTypeJson.join(',') || '' : ''}); if (data.isBlackList === null) delete data.isBlackList; var t = ctx.getNode('TableAsync::supplierTable'); if (t) t.exposed.reloadData({ isReset: payload?.isReset || false, params: data, sort: payload?.sort || {} });  }
